note: gdb freezes the uKernel for a debugger: a process enters a critical section and spins forever. The console is gone until a reset, so the row is terminal - run-board-tests never runs it, board-regression only with --allow-terminal, last, and resets the board afterwards through its probe. The spin (no WFI) keeps the debug port reachable even on Discovery_N657, where a running board is not.

tests.terminal: freezes the kernel for a debugger; only a reset brings it back
tests.note: the instructions for the host come from the freezing process, which freezes one second later (gdb.c: kern_suspendProcess(1000U)) - hence the 2 s wait, which also asserts it froze rather than crashed. Then the console must stay silent
